name: laps-connect
title: LAPS Connect
description: Admin only: find a user's computer via WireGuard (UniFi), fetch its Windows LAPS password from Entra and connect via SSH or RDP
author: mendyka

commands.name: connect
commands.title: LAPS Connect
commands.description: Find a user's computer and connect with its LAPS password

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: Client ID
preferences.description: Application (client) ID of the "Raycast LAPS Connect" app registration

preferences.name: unifiUrl
preferences.title: UniFi URL
preferences.description: Address of the UniFi gateway running the WireGuard server

preferences.name: autoLock
preferences.title: Auto-Lock After
preferences.description: LAPS Connect locks again after this time without use. The UniFi API key is stored encrypted with your LAPS Connect password.

preferences.name: signOutOnLock
preferences.title: On Lock
preferences.label: Also sign out of Microsoft
preferences.description: Every unlock then needs a fresh Microsoft sign-in (incl. MFA) before a LAPS password can be read

preferences.name: unifiInsecure
preferences.title: UniFi TLS
preferences.label: Allow self-signed certificate
preferences.description: UniFi gateways use a self-signed certificate by default

preferences.name: jumpHost
preferences.title: Jump Host
preferences.description: Optional SSH jump host for SSH and RDP: an alias from ~/.ssh/config or user@host:port

preferences.name: nameFilter
preferences.title: WireGuard Name Filter
preferences.description: Regular expression for WireGuard clients to show (default: X-NAME without suffix)

preferences.name: deviceSuffix
preferences.title: Windows Device Suffix
preferences.description: Computer name = WireGuard name + this suffix

preferences.name: clipboardSeconds
preferences.title: Clear Clipboard After
preferences.description: The LAPS password is removed from the clipboard after this time
